dialogs.about: 손녀 생일 잔치를 준비하며 며느리와 이야기

lines.en: Today is our granddaughter's birthday party.
Yes! Did you buy the cake this morning?
lines.ko: 네! 오늘 아침에 케이크 사 오셨어요?

lines.en: I bought the cake an hour ago.
Where are the candles and the balloons?
They are on the table in the box.
Let's put seven candles on the cake.
Good idea. Who will blow them out?
She will blow out the candles and make a wish.
lines.ko: 아이가 초를 불어 끄고 소원을 빌 거예요.

lines.en: I have a small gift for her too.
lines.ko: 나도 아이에게 줄 작은 선물이 있어요.

lines.en: That's a nice surprise. Thank you, Mother.
lines.ko: 정말 좋은 깜짝 선물이에요. 어머니, 고마워요.

lines.en: Excuse me. I want to order a birthday cake.
Of course. When is the party?
It's this Saturday at my son's house.
How many candles do you need?
Seven candles, please. She likes pink flowers.
lines.ko: 초 일곱 개 주세요. 그 아이는 분홍 꽃을 좋아해요.

lines.en: We can write her name on the cake.
lines.ko: 케이크에 아이 이름을 써 드릴 수 있어요.

lines.en: Can you give me two balloons too?
lines.ko: 풍선도 두 개 주실 수 있어요?

lines.en: Yes. I will put the balloons in your bag.
Thank you. I ordered a cake here last year.
Yes, I remember you from last year. See you!
lines.ko: 네, 작년에 오신 것 기억나요. 또 봬요!
